description: Designly is a commercial Art Direction and Design Neural Mesh plugin with 21 focused Skills, 16 custom Codex agents, a copy-first Prompt Playground, Cannes-calibrated Creative Direction, 571 Legendary Campaign Canon, dramaturgy-first AI Video Direction (Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo), model-physics Image Direction (Nano Banana 2/Pro, GPT Image 2), Insight Mining, Brand Activation, Visual Storytelling, Taste Engine, Reference Memory, bounded-edit sanitization, Arabic RTL direction, and independent Visual QA.

defaultPrompt: Show me the Designly Prompt Playground and give me 5 copy-ready experiments to try.
Art-direct this campaign end-to-end, using specialist review and strict design gates.
Direct a 15-second cinematic video sequence for Kling or Seedance with 14-field shot cards.
interface.longDescription:
Designly turns a brief, idea, or reference into polished visual work for ads, social campaigns, brand content, and cinematic AI films

The Prompt Playground gives users copy-ready experiments that demonstrate Designly through real creative jobs instead of a feature list

It shapes creative concepts, dramaturgy, composition, typography, optics, and model physics (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image 2), reviews every output critically, and routes targeted revisions

You can also sanitize annotation-guided inpainting, follow brand guidelines, handle Arabic and RTL layouts, and maintain visual continuity across multi-asset campaigns
